gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A TU Wien Informatics academic supervisor is needed for the dissertation, and candidates contact professors directly to ask.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to have an academic supervisor at TU Wien Informatics for my dissertation? Yes.

also.quote: Contact them directly to inquire if they agree to supervise your dissertation.

funding.value: Most doctoral candidates are employed by TU Wien, often through a Doctoral College or research project, though some are self-funded.
funding.quote: While some candidates are self-funded, most are employed by TU Wien

entry_route.value: A relevant master's, teacher training or other appropriate degree is the prerequisite for admission to a TU Wien doctoral programme.
entry_route.quote: The prerequisite for admission to a doctoral programme at TU Wien is either successful completion of a relevant master's, teacher training or other appropriate degree programme

notes: The Informatics Doctoral School page lists research areas such as artificial intelligence, but no separate data science or ML doctoral track was found, so datasci is not saved.
